title: 한국도로공사법 시행규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00120:20140807:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Partial Amendment Ordinance of the Enforcement Rules of the Framework Act on the Construction Industry, etc. for Protection of Personal Information) <No. 120, August 7, 2014>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.
Article 2 (Transitional Measures concerning Forms) Forms being used under the former provisions at the time these Rules enter into force may continue to be used, but portions from which resident registration numbers are deleted or changed to dates of birth under these Rules shall be deleted or corrected before use.
